messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Balance 14.50 EUR is below the WORLD_2GB price of 19 EUR; the pack cannot be added.", "verifier": {"reason": "The current action violates two norms: (1) The prepaid balance (14.50 EUR) is insufficient for the WORLD_2GB pack (19 EUR), and (2) while confirmation was obtained, the assistant did not ensure the balance was sufficient before proceeding. The policy requires both conditions to be met before executing `add_roaming_pack`."}}
